req.title: Emit Swagger UI
req.statement: The system shall serve interactive Swagger UI documentation at GET /docs.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-018 requires GET /docs to serve interactive Swagger UI documentation with an HTTP 2xx response. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — the happy path returns exactly HTTP 200 with HTML content containing Swagger UI markers; (2) negative NEG — a wrong method (POST /docs) returns HTTP 405, confirming the endpoint is GET-only; (3) boundary BVA — the response Content-Type header is exactly 'text/html; charset=utf-8', catching any mutation that changes the served content type; (4) DT — verifying the response body contains the FastAPI app title string embedded in the Swagger UI page, catching mutations that strip metadata; (5) BVA — verifying the response body length is non-zero and contains the swagger-ui bundle script tag, catching mutations that return an empty or stub body.

tests.name: test_get_docs_returns_200
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_docs_returns_200():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/docs')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert len(response.content) > 0

test_get_docs_returns_200()

trace: R-PLAYER-018: Swagger UI is an HTML document; Content-Type must be text/html
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_docs_content_type_is_html():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/docs')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    content_type = response.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert content_type.startswith('text/html'), (
        f'Expected text/html, got: {content_type}'
    )

test_get_docs_content_type_is_html()

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_docs_body_contains_swagger_ui_marker():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/docs')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    body = response.text
    assert 'swagger-ui' in body, 'Expected swagger-ui marker in body'
    assert 'SwaggerUIBundle' in body, 'Expected SwaggerUIBundle in body'

test_get_docs_body_contains_swagger_ui_marker()

expected: Response body length is strictly greater than 0
Response body length is greater than 100 bytes (not a stub/empty response)
trace: R-PLAYER-018: The Swagger UI page must be a real HTML document, not an empty or minimal stub
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_docs_response_body_length_boundary():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/docs')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    body_len = len(response.content)
    assert body_len > 0, 'Response body must not be empty'
    assert body_len > 100, (
        f'Response body too short ({body_len} bytes); expected a full Swagger UI page'
    )

test_get_docs_response_body_length_boundary()
